## Episode Thesis

This is a macro segment with SEB's US expert Elisabeth Koppelman. It covers the US PCE inflation print, which came in below expectations partly because the measurement method changed, alongside an upward GDP revision driven by strong private consumption. The discussion centres on the Fed probably holding rates in October, persistently rising long-term yields (government debt, hyperscaler AI capex competing for capital, Bank of Japan flows) and a preview of the upcoming NFP jobs report. No individual stocks are discussed with a directional view; the tone is cautious and mixed, seeing stronger growth against the risk that rates stay high.
